subject.title: feat(agents): Swarm core — collector spawn, agents_wait, structured output, caps (gated)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `tools.swarm`, `agents_wait`, and the associated persisted collector contract as a supported core feature rather than continue this work behind a narrower experimental or plugin boundary?
rationale: This PR adds durable core configuration, protocol, tool, scheduler, and state semantics; code review cannot determine the intended long-term public contract or support commitment.

options.title: Sponsor a gated core v1
options.body: Confirm the core Swarm direction, then require the diagnostic fix and enabled-path upgrade/runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Keep the collector implementation experimental or reduce the public config and protocol surface before accepting a permanent compatibility commitment.

options.title: Pause the core lane
options.body: Defer this feature until the broader Swarm program has an explicitly approved product and ownership plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a gated core v1
recommendation.body: Confirm the core Swarm direction, then require the diagnostic fix and enabled-path upgrade/runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked program and this branch's Swarm specification are authored and actively updated by steipete.
